message.content: {"rules":["Implementations of SourceIter::as_inner must return the same mutable reference for their lifetime, unless it is replaced by a caller.","Callers of SourceIter::as_inner may replace the reference only when they have stopped iteration and drop the iterator pipeline after extracting the source.","SourceIter adapters may rely on the source not changing during iteration, but must not rely on it remaining unchanged in their Drop implementations.","Adapters implementing SourceIter::as_inner must not rely on private-only access to their source; they may rely only on guarantees based on method receiver types.","Adapters implementing SourceIter::as_inner must uphold the source's public API even when they have access to its internals.","Callers of SourceIter::as_inner must allow the source to be in any state consistent with its public API, including a state in which intermediate adapters have consumed more elements than strictly necessary."]}
